description: This PHP class manages a registry of URI scheme validator objects for the HTMLPurifier library, allowing retrieval and registration of scheme validators.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URISchemeRegistry
classes.description: A singleton registry class responsible for managing URI scheme validator objects, providing methods to retrieve, register, and reset scheme validators.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry, optionally resetting or replacing it with a prototype.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Fetches a scheme validator object based on the scheme name, configuration, and context, creating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new scheme validator object to the registry, bypassing reflection.
